claim: Selected-capability loading always waits. Seat-access loading waits only when allowWork is false. Then a capable seat-access displays ChatSeatAccessScreen before selected-capability denial can redirect home.

claim: allowWork=true bypasses the seat-access wait and screen. Selected capability false redirects home; true wraps children in Suspense. isError is not read directly by oZ.
method: static source and saved lexical-contract review

claim: The capability evaluator combines policies, flags, settings and config-feature results. A loaded config-feature list lacking the requested entry passes the enabled!==false condition; loading/error still prevent that branch from being capable.
method: static source and saved lexical-contract review
